title: User cannot submit registration without any mandatory fields
gherkin:
Feature: Registration Mandatory Fields
  Scenario: Submit registration form with all mandatory fields empty
    Given the user is on the registration page
    When the user attempts to submit the registration form without filling any fields
    Then the form submission should be rejected
    And error messages should be displayed for all mandatory fields
rationale: Validates that the registration form enforces mandatory field requirements and prevents submission when all required fields are empty.
generationSummary: Test cases for registration mandatory fields requirement. These tests verify that the registration form enforces all required fields and prevents submission without them, while also validating proper error handling and user feedback when mandatory fields are missing or invalid.
